name: Jamiro
author: Yann
summary: Novation X-Station-style polysynth (KS engine): 8 voices, 3 oscillators with sync, FM and ring mod, multimode filter, 2 envelopes, 2 LFOs, arpeggiator and effects. Loads your own X-Station/KS .syx banks from Content/Banks. Independent project, not affiliated with Novation.
